app.name: Agrimate
nav.label: Main menu
lang.needsInternet: This language needs internet the first time.
offline.banner: No internet. Showing your last saved information.
offline.waiting: {n} waiting to be sent when internet returns.
secure.upload: Sending photos needs a secure (https) link. Please open the app from its https address.
error.network: No internet connection. Please try again when you have signal.
error.badInput: Some details are not correct. Please check and try again.
error.tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait a little and try again.
error.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again soon.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
apiError.OTP_INVALID: This code is wrong or too old. Please check it or ask for a new one.
apiError.OTP_RATE_LIMITED: Too many codes asked for. Please try again after some time.
apiError.SIGNUP_DETAILS_REQUIRED: This number is new. Please enter your name.
apiError.KYC_REQUIRED: First finish your PAN and bank details.
apiError.FARMER_LOCATION_MISSING: Your farm location is missing. Please add it in your PAN and bank details.
apiError.PIN_UNKNOWN: We do not know this PIN code. Stand at your farm and tap the location button.
apiError.GRADE_INVALID: This grade does not belong to this crop. Please choose again.
apiError.ORGANIC_CERT_INVALID: This organic certificate is not verified or has expired.
apiError.ORGANIC_REQUIRED: This buyer wants organic only. You need a verified certificate that has not expired.
apiError.PRICE_INVALID: The price must be more than zero.
apiError.BID_QUANTITY: Your bid must be for the full quantity.
apiError.BID_PRICE: Your price cannot be more than the buyer's price.
apiError.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: This can no longer be done. It may have closed or changed.
apiError.GUARD_FAILED: This cannot be done yet. The buyer's payment may not be complete.
apiError.CONCURRENT_UPDATE: This order just changed. Please try again.
apiError.USE_TRIP_PICKUP: The transport partner confirms when the truck leaves.
apiError.FILE_NOT_FOUND: The file was not found. Please send it again.
apiError.FILE_WRONG_PURPOSE: This is the wrong kind of file. Please send it again.
apiError.FILE_NOT_COMPLETE: The file did not finish sending. Please send it again.
apiError.FILE_NOT_UPLOADED: The file has not arrived yet. Please send it again.
apiError.UPLOAD_FAILED: Sending failed. Please check your internet and try again.
apiError.HASH_MISMATCH: The file was damaged while sending. Please record or send it again.
apiError.SELF_CERT_NOT_ACTIVE: Videos are needed only when no inspector is available. This order does not need them.
apiError.CAPTURE_TOKEN_REQUIRED: This video can only be recorded inside this app.
apiError.CAPTURE_TOKEN_INVALID: This recording session has ended. Please record again.
apiError.NOT_IN_APP_CAPTURE: This video was not recorded in this session. Please record again.
apiError.TIMESTAMP_OUT_OF_WINDOW: The recording time is not accepted. Check that the date and time on your phone are correct, then record again.
apiError.OUTSIDE_RADIUS: You are {metres} metres from your farm's saved location. Go within {radius} metres of it and record again.
apiError.VIDEOS_REQUIRED: Both videos are needed first: the scale and the loaded vehicle.
gps.denied: Location is blocked for this app. Open your phone settings, allow Location for this app, and try again.
gps.failed: Could not find your location. Go to an open place, turn on Location, and try again.
login.title: Log in with your phone
login.subtitle: We will send a code to your number.
login.newBody: Enter your name. We have sent a new code; please enter that one.
login.name: Your name
login.notFarmer: This number belongs to another kind of account. Please use a farmer number.
home.title: Home
home.kycNeededTitle: Finish your PAN and bank details
home.kycNeededBody: You need this before you can sell or get paid.
home.kycRejectedTitle: Your PAN could not be verified
home.kycRejectedBody: Please check your PAN and send it again.
home.kycReviewBody: We are checking your bank name. You can still sell.
home.negativeBody: This will be taken from your next payment.
home.noOrdersBody: Bid on a buyer's request or put your crop up for sale.
next.title: What to do next
next.waitAdvance: Wait for the buyer's advance payment. Do not harvest yet.
next.inspectionFailed: The inspection found a problem with quality. Agrimate or the buyer will decide what happens next.
next.recordVideos: No inspector is available. Record 2 short videos on this phone: the scale and the loaded vehicle.
next.submitWeight: Your videos are ready. Enter the final weight and send.
next.waitBalanceVideosDone: Your videos are saved. Wait for the buyer's full payment, then enter the weight.
next.harvestNow: Advance received. Harvest now and keep the crop ready for {date}.
next.inspectionDay: Full payment received. Keep the crop ready for inspection on {date}.
next.dispatchPhotos: Quality is done. Take photos of the loaded crop.
next.confirmDeparted: Photos are saved. Tell us when the truck leaves.
next.waitTruck: Photos are saved. Wait for the truck to collect the crop.
next.inTransit: Your crop is on the way to the buyer.
next.paymentSoon: Crop delivered. The buyer can raise a problem until {date}. After that you are paid.
next.disputed: The buyer has raised a problem. Agrimate is checking it. Your money is safe until it is decided.
next.paid: This order is finished and settled.
account.title: My account
account.name: Name
kyc.title: PAN and bank details
kyc.intro: We need these to pay money into your bank.
kyc.panInvalid: This PAN does not look right.
kyc.bankInvalid: An account number has 6 to 20 digits.
kyc.ifscHint: 11 letters and numbers, on your passbook
kyc.ifscInvalid: This IFSC does not look right.
kyc.holderHint: Must be the same as the name on your PAN
kyc.pinUnknown: We do not know this PIN code. Please also save your farm location below.
kyc.locationBody: Stand at your farm and tap the button. If you ever record videos for an order, you must be near this place.
kyc.changeWarning: If you send new details, they will be checked again. Payments may stop until that is done.
kyc.verifiedBody: Your PAN and bank name match. Payments to your bank are on.
kyc.mismatchTitle: Bank name does not match your PAN
kyc.mismatchBody: Payments to you are blocked until Agrimate checks this. You can still sell and bid.
kyc.bankInvalidTitle: Bank account could not be verified
kyc.bankInvalidBody: Payments to you are blocked until this is fixed. You can still sell and bid.
kyc.whatNextBody: An Agrimate person will check it. Or send a bank account that is in the same name as your PAN.
kyc.rejectedBody: You cannot sell or get paid yet. Please check your PAN number and send it again.
listings.title: My crop for sale
listings.emptyBody: Add your crop so that buyers can see it.
listing.title: Sell a crop
listing.price: Your price in rupees per kg
listing.organicHint: Only verified certificates that have not expired can be chosen.
listing.sentBody: Buyers can see it now. We will tell you when someone buys it.
listing.queuedBody: It will be sent by itself when internet returns.
listing.kycTitle: Finish your PAN and bank details first
listing.kycBody: You cannot sell or bid until these are sent.
organic.title: Organic certificates
organic.intro: Send a photo of your certificate. You can sell as organic after Agrimate verifies it.
organic.fileHint: Take a clear photo of the full page
organic.sentBody: Agrimate will check it. You can choose it when selling after that.
rfqs.title: Buyers' requests
rfqs.intro: Buyers looking for crops now. Your bid must be for the full quantity.
bid.title: Make a bid
bid.quantityHint: You must supply the full quantity.
bid.price: Your price in rupees per kg
bid.overTarget: Your price cannot be more than {max} rupees.
bid.sentBody: We will tell you if the buyer accepts it.
bid.queuedBody: Your bid will be sent by itself when internet returns.
orders.title: My orders
order.paymentsIntro: Money the buyer has paid into safe holding for this order.
settlement.title: What you will get
settlement.remaining: You will still owe {amount} after this.
settlement.note: This is an estimate. The final amount is fixed when the order is settled.
inspection.title: Inspection report
inspection.deviationAccepted: The buyer accepted the crop as it is.
dispatch.title: Dispatch photos
dispatch.intro: Take clear photos of your crop loaded and ready. This protects you if there is a problem later.
dispatch.offline: No internet now. Photos need internet to send.
dispatch.departBody: Tap only after the crop has left your farm.
selfcert.title: Quality videos
selfcert.intro: No inspector is available, so you record 2 short videos on this phone at your farm. The buyer will see them.
selfcert.scaleStep1: Put your crop on the weighing scale.
selfcert.scaleStep2: Point the camera so the number on the scale can be read clearly.
selfcert.scaleStep3: Press record and hold still until the time is complete.
selfcert.vehicleStep1: Load your crop on the vehicle.
selfcert.vehicleStep2: Point the camera at the load and at the number plate.
selfcert.vehicleStep3: Press record and walk slowly around the vehicle.
selfcert.fail.gpsDenied.title: Location is blocked
selfcert.fail.gpsDenied.body: Videos must show where they were recorded. Open your phone settings, allow Location for this app, and try again.
selfcert.fail.gpsFailed.title: Could not find your location
selfcert.fail.gpsFailed.body: Go to an open place, turn on Location, and try again.
selfcert.fail.cameraDenied.title: Camera is blocked
selfcert.fail.cameraDenied.body: Open your phone settings, allow Camera for this app, and try again.
selfcert.fail.cameraMissing.title: No camera found
selfcert.fail.cameraMissing.body: This phone has no camera we can use. Please use another phone.
selfcert.fail.cameraBusy.title: Camera is busy
selfcert.fail.cameraBusy.body: Close other apps that use the camera and try again.
selfcert.fail.interrupted.title: Recording stopped
selfcert.fail.interrupted.body: The camera was interrupted. Keep the screen on and record again.
selfcert.fail.empty.title: The video is empty
selfcert.fail.empty.body: Nothing was recorded. Please record again.
selfcert.insecureBody: The camera and video sealing work only on a secure (https) link. Please open the app from its https address.
selfcert.unsupportedBody: Please update Chrome on this phone, or use another phone. Videos can only be recorded inside this app.
selfcert.offlineBody: Each recording must first get a code from Agrimate. Go to a place with signal.
selfcert.notRequired: This order has an inspector, so it does not need videos.
selfcert.doneBody: Weight sent: {kg} kg. The buyer will see that you self-certified.
selfcert.bothDoneBody: Now enter the final weight in kg.
selfcert.notFundedTitle: Waiting for the buyer's full payment
selfcert.notFundedBody: You can send the weight after the buyer has paid in full.
selfcert.declaration: By sending, you confirm that this weight and these videos are true.
ledger.title: My money
ledger.negativeWhat: An earlier order failed, and a bank charge on it was recorded against you.
ledger.negativeHow: You do not need to pay this now. It is taken from your next payment, and the rest comes to your bank.
ledger.blockedBody: Your money is safe but cannot go to your bank until your bank name is checked.
ledger.blockedBankName: The name on your bank account has not been matched with your PAN.
ledger.payoutFailed: The bank transfer failed. Agrimate will try again.
journal.DEFAULT_FEE_RECOVERY: Bank charge on a failed order
